high_level_description: This image depicts a serene late afternoon scene on a wooden boardwalk. The boardwalk extends into the distance, leading towards a horizon that is slightly hazy, suggesting a calm and peaceful atmosphere. The sky above is clear with a soft gradient of light blue, indicating it might be early evening. The boardwalk itself is made of weathered wooden planks, showing signs of age and exposure to the elements. On either side of the boardwalk, there are metal railings that provide safety for those walking along it.
